name: Maren Kowalczyk-Hart
title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior software engineer with ten years building marketplaces and the payment and search systems behind them. Owns services from the first design review to the on-call rotation, prefers small, well-tested changes to big rewrites, and has helped six engineers grow into senior roles.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description: Leads the checkout and payouts team for a wholesale marketplace moving $900M a year between 14,000 sellers and buyers.
achievements: Rebuilt seller payouts on an idempotent job queue, ending duplicate transfers and cutting support tickets about payouts by 70%
Brought checkout p95 latency from 1.9s to 420ms by moving tax and shipping quotes behind a Redis cache
Introduced feature flags and staged rollouts, so the team ships to production twice a day instead of twice a month
Coached three engineers to senior; one now leads the search team

experience.title: Software Engineer II
experience.description: Built the event pipeline and query service for a retail analytics product used by 400 brands.
achievements: Designed an event ingestion path on Kafka handling 3 billion events a month with replay after outages
Shipped a pre-aggregation layer that took dashboard loads from 12 seconds to under 2
Moved the reporting database from one large server to a partitioned PostgreSQL cluster with no customer downtime

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description: Full-stack work on an online course platform, from the React course player to the grading service.
achievements: Rewrote the course player in React, lifting lesson completion rates by 18%
Built the CI pipeline the engineering group still uses, taking a release from an afternoon to 15 minutes

experience.title: Junior Developer
experience.description: Built and maintained client websites and internal tools for a small agency.
achievements: Automated deployments for 25 client sites, ending a recurring source of broken releases

strengths.title: Pragmatic design
strengths.description: Picks the simplest design that will survive the next two years of growth.

strengths.title: Mentorship
strengths.description: Six engineers coached into senior roles over five years.

strengths.title: Incident ownership
strengths.description: Runs the review through to the fix that stops the incident coming back.

strengths.title: Clear writing
strengths.description: Design documents that people read before the meeting.
